title: Red-Black Tree
description: Write a Zig program that implements a Red-Black tree with insertion and color validation.
verificationTest: output.includes('Root: 10 (Black)') && output.includes('Right: 20 (Red)') && output.includes('Right-right red chain detected')
hints: Red-Black trees use a color (Red/Black) per node for balancing
`enum` in Zig can be used to define the Color type
No red node can have a red child (no red-red chains)
